strategy.instructionFix: When a paragraph starts with You should spend... but also contains title/body after below, only the instruction prefix is stripped and the body is retained.
strategy.embeddedQuestionFix: If a question marker appears inside a reading paragraph, content after the marker and all following paragraphs are treated as recovered question text.
strategy.answerKeyFilter: Answer-key and score-band paragraphs are excluded from main Markdown question explanations but retained in recovered source evidence when present.
strategy.questionAssociation: Question sections are associated by parsed question numbers into 1-13, 14-26, 27-40; mislabelled kind=reading Question sections are treated as questions.
strategy.recovery: Suspicious embedded questions, missing question coverage, or OCR/page split anomalies are recorded under recovered-sources without changing source OCR or bank files.
strategy.translationNote: Offline Chinese paragraphs are generated as natural paragraph-level interpretive translations/译读 with source-order coverage; source English remains visible for checking.
